# thousandeyes_endpoint_tests_agent_to_server (Resource)

Retrieve agent to server endpoint scheduled test.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `agent_selector_type` (String) Specifies how agents are selected for the endpoint test. Agents can be selected from: - all available agents - a specific list of agents - agents matching tags - agents matching labels (deprecated) Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `agents` (Set of String) List of endpoint agent IDs (obtained from `/endpoint/agents` endpoint). Required when `agentSelectorType` is set to `specific-agent`. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `endpoint_agent_labels` (Set of String, Deprecated) Deprecated. Use `tagIds` instead. List of endpoint agent label IDs (obtained from `/endpoint/labels` endpoint), required when `agentSelectorType` is set to `agent-labels`. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `interval` (Number) Interval between test runs in seconds.
- `ip_version` (String) For reading current network test configurations, the IP version of the test. Values include V4_ONLY, V6_ONLY, V6_PREFER, and OS_DEFAULT. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `is_prioritized` (Boolean) Indicates whether the test should be prioritized when the number of tests assigned to an agent exceeds the license limit. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `max_machines` (Number) Maximum number of agents which can execute the test. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `port` (Number) Port number.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol requested for the test.
- `server` (String) Target domain name or IP address.
- `server_name` (String, Deprecated) A server address without a protocol or IP address. **Deprecated, use `server` instead**. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `tag_ids` (Set of String) List of tag IDs (obtained from `/tags` endpoint). Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `test_name` (String) Name of the test.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `aid` (String) A unique identifier associated with your account group. You can retrieve your `AccountGroupId` from the `/account-groups` endpoint.
- `created_date` (String) UTC created date (ISO date-time format).
- `has_path_trace_in_session` (Boolean) Enables "in session" path trace. When enabled, this option initiates a TCP session with the target server and sends path trace packets within the established TCP session.
- `id` (String) The test's unique identifier, assigned by the API.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates if test is enabled.
- `is_saved_event` (Boolean) Indicates if the test is a saved event. **Note**: **Saved Events** are now called **Private Snapshots** in the user interface. This change does not affect API.
- `labels` (Attributes Set) Labels to which the test is assigned. This field is not returned for Instant Tests. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))
- `modified_date` (String) UTC last modification date (ISO date-time format).
- `network_measurements` (Boolean) Enable or disable network measurements. Set to true to enable or false to disable network measurements.
- `tcp_probe_mode` (String) Probe mode returned by network test APIs, only valid when the protocol is set to TCP. Configuration responses return user-selectable values, while result responses may also return resolved driver values.
- `test_id` (String) Each test is assigned a unique ID to access test data from other endpoints.
- `type` (String) Type of test being queried.
